text: What to do when you think she's too good for you? Let's say you are on a date. She's gorgeous, perfectly dressed, maybe studied abroad, speaks three languages. And you're thinking, wow, she's out of my league. How can I impress her? Stop right there. That's you putting her on a pedestal and shrinking yourself in the process. The real problem isn't her beauty, education or lifestyle. It's that deep down, you don't feel enough in your own eyes. If you don't believe you bring value, no day tricks will fix it. She'll feel that instantly. So shift your mindset. She's already on a date with you. Out of all the guys out there, she chose to spend her time with you. That means there's already something great about you, whether you see it or not. Yeah, she might be stunning and well-dressed, but at the end of the day, she's still just a girl looking to have a good time with someone she likes. Why can't that be you? Of course, don't stop there. Keep improving yourself. Looks, fitness, knowledge, career, hobbies. The more you grow, the more naturally confident you become. And here's the magic. The more you meet beautiful women who like you for who you are, the less you will think she's out of my league. Instead, you'll think she's lucky to be here with me.
